zh.title: Volotea 進入債權人協商前置程序　規劃將機隊縮至 30 至 35 架
zh.summary: 公司表示營運維持正常，將利用西班牙重整程序協商債務與增資，目標在 12 月完成方案。
body: Volotea 已向巴塞隆納第 9 商事法院提交 preconcurso 通知，啟動與債權人協商的前置程序。這項機制讓公司在管理層維持控制的情況下協商重整，並不等同已進入正式破產程序。
公司表示航班營運維持正常，目標在 2026 年 12 月前完成債務重整與增資方案。Volotea 稱燃油成本衝擊約 1.5 億歐元，是財務壓力的重要因素之一。
重整計畫包括將機隊由 44 架調整為約 30 至 35 架，並精簡成本。具體退租或停飛的飛機名單，以及最終融資條件，仍待協商完成。

en.title: Volotea enters preliminary creditor talks and plans to reduce fleet to 30–35 aircraft
en.summary: The airline says operations remain normal while it negotiates debt restructuring and new capital, aiming to complete a plan in December.
body: Volotea has filed a preconcurso notice with Barcelona Commercial Court No. 9, opening a preliminary period for negotiations with creditors. The Spanish process gives the company room to negotiate while management remains in control and is not the same as entering formal insolvency proceedings.

The airline says flight operations remain normal and it aims to complete a debt-restructuring and recapitalization plan by December 2026. Volotea says fuel costs have created an impact of about EUR150 million.
The plan includes reducing the fleet from 44 aircraft to roughly 30–35 and lowering costs. Specific aircraft exits and final financing terms remain subject to the negotiations.

facts.claim: Volotea filed a preconcurso notice to open preliminary creditor negotiations while continuing normal operations.
The airline aims to complete its restructuring and recapitalization plan by December 2026 and cites a EUR150 million fuel-cost impact.
Volotea plans to reduce its fleet from 44 aircraft to approximately 30-35.
